name: Armis Centrix
description: This plugin is used to pull Devices from the Assets > Devices page of the Armis Centrix platform, optionally with their custom properties. It also supports the 'Set Custom Property Value' action and the 'Remove Custom Property Value' action.

configuration.label: API Base URL
configuration.description: API Base URL of the Armis Centrix platform. e.g. https://api.armis.com.

configuration.label: Tenant URL
configuration.description: Tenant URL of the Armis Centrix platform. e.g. https://acme.armis.com.

configuration.label: Client ID
configuration.description: Email address of the Armis Centrix user who generated the Secret API key.

configuration.label: Client Secret
configuration.description: Secret API key of the Armis Centrix platform. To get the Secret API key, go to Settings > Asset Management & Security > Data Sources > API Management > Generate Tokens > Secret API key.

configuration.label: Vendor ID
configuration.description: Vendor ID of the Armis Centrix platform. To get the Vendor ID, go to Settings > Asset Management & Security > Data Sources > API Management > Developer Portal > Your Vendor ID.

configuration.label: Scopes
configuration.description: Armis Centrix permissions requested for the access token. 'Device Pull' (PERMISSION.DEVICE.READ, PERMISSION.PII.DEVICE, FULL_VISIBILITY) pulls the devices. 'Custom Properties Pull' (PERMISSION.SETTINGS.CUSTOM_PROPERTIES.READ) reads the custom properties; it is required when Pull Custom Properties is 'Yes' and for the actions. 'Custom Actions' (PERMISSION.DEVICE.MANAGE.EDIT, PERMISSION.SETTINGS.CUSTOM_PROPERTIES.MANAGE) is required for the actions. Select 'Custom Permissions' to request additional permissions.
